name: Velox Energy Materials Inc.
summary: Velox Energy Materials Inc., an exploration stage company, engages in the exploration of resource properties in Australia. The company holds a 100% interest in the North Queensland vanadium project, which hosts the Cambridge deposit covering an area of 1,246 square kilometers located in northwest Queensland. It also operates the Kotai hydrogen project, which targets the safe transport of hydrogen through inert materials. The company was formerly known as Currie Rose Resources Inc. and changed its name to Velox Energy Materials Inc. in October 2023. Velox Energy Materials Inc. was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
